response.sql: WITH copies AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating) SELECT film_id, rating, copies, copies - AVG(copies) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS diff_from_rating_avg, copies - AVG(copies) OVER () AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM copies ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Films with no inventory rows get 0 copies via LEFT JOIN and COUNT(inventory_id), and are included in both averages. The overall average is computed over all films (not over rating averages). Ties in the ordering are broken arbitrarily.
